questions.solution_text:
As $x$ increases, $\frac{10}{x}$ decreases, so on each strip the function is largest at the left edge.
Each rectangle is drawn at that largest height, so its top lies above the curve across the whole strip.
The total of the rectangles is therefore larger than the true area, so the estimate is an over-estimate.
